mechanism.statement: Currencies whose EX-POST REAL short rate (effective policy rate minus the most recently published year-over-year CPI inflation) sits above their counterpart's by a threshold band relative to its trailing one-year median tend to APPRECIATE over the following 20 sessions (capital-attracted-to-real-yield channel; sticky-price Frankel dynamics). The tradeable signal is the real differential, not the nominal differential: the inflation leg enters with the OPPOSITE sign to the policy-rate leg.

construction.real_rate_r(area,t): i_eff(area, t) - cpi_yoy_latest_available(area, t), annualized percentage points
construction.i_eff: BIS WS_CBPOL effective policy rate read from the evidenced vintage as-of decision time t (vintage pipeline fed by pinned announcement ledger ae5e1f2e..., LEDGER_PINNED in research/control/forex_free_v4_run/)
construction.cpi_yoy_latest_available: most recent YoY CPI print of the area whose evidenced availability stamp (operative_available_time_utc) is <= decision time t; read exactly once from the evidenced vintage; replay never
construction.normalizer_M(pair,t): trailing 252-session median of D(pair, .) computed on the same as-of evidenced reads
construction.state_rule: LONG base vs quote when D >= M + F; SHORT base vs quote when D <= M - F; flat when |D - M| < F

mechanism.why_this_is_NOT_a_policy_carry_relabel: a carry mechanism conditions on sign(i_base - i_quote); this mechanism conditions on sign((i_b - i_q) - (pi_b - pi_q)). The two disagree whenever |pi_b - pi_q| moves the differential across the band: e.g. JP vs US through 2022-2024 had i_us > i_jp (carry LONG USD) while realized US inflation exceeded Japanese inflation for much of that window, compressing or reversing the real differential. The preregistered placebo control (inflation-sign inversion) makes the disagreement measurable: if anchor and control decision sets are near-identical, the inflation channel is inert and the family fails. A7-N is asked to measure anchor rank correlation against BOTH V3 family2 anchor variants (as-scored and evidenced-availability corrected books); this packet expects a materially sub-1 rho in the inflation-divergent subperiods and discloses that the policy-rate leg is shared machinery, not the claimed signal.

falsifiable_prediction.primary: Positions taken per the state rule above have strictly positive after-cost expectancy on the financing-adjusted book (mean PnL per trade > 0 at base costs 1.5 bps per fill), over the full 2019-01..2026-09 scored window and in at least 2 of 3 forced-flat time folds.
falsified_if_any: anchor fin-adj expectancy <= 0 at base tier
fewer than 2 of 3 populated folds positive
stress tier 1.5 or tier 2.0 book (multipliers applied to booked stress PnL) negative
placebo control (inflation-sign-inverted differential) reproduces the anchor's Stage-A gate outcome and >= 90% decision overlap -> inflation channel judged non-causal
falsifiable_prediction.quantitative_direction_claim: E[currency return over 20 sessions | real differential above trailing median by >= 0.25 pp] > 0 after 3.0 bps round-trip cost, and the claim is specifically NOT explained by the nominal-differential component (tested by the placebo control arm)

literature.citation: Frankel, J.A. (1979), 'On the Mark: A Theory of Floating Exchange Rates Based on Real Interest Differentials', American Economic Review 69(4), 610-622
literature.role: names the mechanism class: real (not nominal) interest differentials drive exchange rates under sticky prices; predicts appreciation of the high-real-rate currency

literature.citation: Fisher, I. (1930), The Theory of Interest, Macmillan
literature.role: real-rate construction i - pi; nominal anchor of the differential

literature.citation: Meese, R.A. and Rogoff, K. (1983), 'Empirical exchange rate models of the seventies: Do they fit out of sample?', Journal of International Economics 14(1-2), 3-24
literature.role: sober prior: fundamentals including interest differentials historically fail to beat a random walk out of sample; motivates the honest expectation that the expectancy margin may be thin or negative

literature.citation: Mark, N.C. (1995), 'Exchange Rates and Fundamentals: Evidence on Long-Horizon Predictability', American Economic Review 85(1), 201-218
literature.role: differential-class predictability improves at long horizons; supports choosing a 20-session-plus holding window as the shortest honest test rather than intraday clocks

literature.citation: Engel, C. and West, K.D. (2005), 'Exchange Rates and Fundamentals', Journal of Political Economy 113(3), 485-517
literature.role: present-value framing: exchange rates respond to expected future fundamentals; small short-horizon R2 is consistent with the mechanism while bounding expected per-trade effect size

literature.citation: Cheung, Y.-W., Chinn, M.D. and Pascual, A.G. (2005), 'Empirical exchange rate models of the nineties: Are any fit to survive?', Journal of International Money and Finance 24(7), 1150-1175
literature.role: modern replication of the Meese-Rogoff exercise; no robust fundamental model survivor, further bounding priors
literature.confidence: confident the paper exists; volume/page numbers from memory [unverified-precision]

decision_clock.event: 16:00 America/New_York every FX session, DST-aware (20:00 UTC in EDT, 21:00 UTC in EST; same convention as ledger first_readable_decision_utc stamps)
decision_clock.read_rule: at each decision event the family reads each conditioning series exactly once, as-of that event's evidenced availability stamps; observed-once / replay-never

universe.justification: the authorized 7-pair universe, verbatim from the run contract; no subset selection, no additions

warmup.macro: >= 13 monthly evidenced CPI prints per area AND full policy-rate ledger baseline coverage per area (all 8 baselines evidenced in the pinned ledger)
warmup.argument: 252 sessions is the median window; 13 prints is the minimum for a stable latest-available YoY read without tying the start date to a specific print's availability
warmup.scored_window: first decision after warmup completes through 2026-09 last session

holding_period.exit_conditions: expiry at 20 sessions OR opposite-band touch at a decision event (D crosses M to the opposite side), whichever first; exit fill next session
holding_period.forced_flat: any position open at a fold boundary is force-flat at the boundary's last session close, per inherited convention

entry_exit_rules.entry: at a decision event, when flat: enter per the state rule (LONG base when D >= M + 0.25pp; SHORT base when D <= M - 0.25pp); when already positioned in the same direction, hold (no re-entry churn); when the band flips, exit and allow opposite entry on the same signal
entry_exit_rules.exit: per holding_period exit conditions; fill next session

fill_convention.fill: next-session bar: every entry/exit fills on the first FX session bar strictly AFTER the decision event's 16:00-NY timestamp
fill_convention.validator_constraint: if no session starts within 4 calendar days of the decision event, the decision is recorded INVALIDATED_NO_SESSION and receives NO fill (never filled late) - the 4-day next-session validator constraint is satisfied by construction, and no arm (including controls) can emit a fill that violates the one-event-lag rule because every decision already lags its conditioning reads by at least one full session (16:00-NY decision -> next session open)
fill_convention.no_lookahead: conditioning reads use only vintages whose evidenced availability stamp precedes the decision event

anchor.spec: mechanism as constructed above, single frozen parameter set
anchor.decisions: daily 16:00-NY on every FX session in the scored window

neighbour.one_presumption_away: normalization presumption only: replace trailing-median + fixed-floor activation with trailing 252-session z-score activation (enter when |z| >= 0.5, direction by sign of z)
neighbour.gate_role: neighbour supports the anchor if its gate-relevant diagnostics are directionally consistent (neighbour need not pass every gate; the Stage-A 'neighbour supports' gate is judged on rank-agreement of per-pair expectancy signs)

control.role: placebo-style causal control isolating the inflation channel
control.spec: identical machinery EXCEPT the CPI term enters with inverted sign: D_placebo = (i_b + pi_b) - (i_q + pi_q) = nominal differential + inflation differential (algebraically D + 2*(pi_b - pi_q)); all availability semantics, fills, holding, costs identical
control.preregistered_non_reproduction_rule: the control must (i) produce decision sets differing from the anchor in at least 3 of 7 pairs by at least one entry date each, AND (ii) not pass the anchor's full Stage-A gate set. If the control reproduces the anchor's pass/fail status with >= 90% decision overlap, the inflation channel is judged non-causal and the family FAILS regardless of the anchor's raw PnL
control.runs_to_completion_guarantee: the control uses the same evidenced reads, same legal vintage semantics, same next-session fills - its book executes under exactly the validator constraints as the anchor; no refused-by-construction arm anywhere in this packet (V3R lesson FX-C4/P-3)

incremental_benchmark.spec: usd_drift_63d_benchmark_v1: at each decision event, hold every pair in the sign of the trailing 63-session USD index drift (USD index computed in-runner from the authorized 7-pair snapshot, inherited H2 fix), 20-session holding, identical fills and costs

incremental_test.alpha_definition: a5_realrate_per_pair_day_normalized_v1: expectancy(anchor, fin-adj, per pair per day in position) - expectancy(benchmark, fin-adj, per pair per day in position), aggregated pair-weighted; gate: overall incremental alpha > 0
incremental_test.rationale: the natural confounder of a US-centric real-rate signal is USD itself; the USD-drift benchmark absorbs direction bias so the gate tests information beyond USD momentum
incremental_test.dual_book: financing-adjusted book governs; price-only book reported and must not invert sign

costs.charging: once per fill (entry and exit each charged), inherited accounting kernel
costs.application: F1-fixed: stress multipliers applied to BOOKED stress PnL (proportional scaling of each trade's booked PnL), never to gross assumptions
costs.tier_is_primary_gate: STRESS_TIER_2.0 is a primary Stage-A gate, not an appendix
costs.break_even_bps: break-even bps per fill reported per cell (fin-adj expectancy zero-cross in bps), mandatory

turnover_and_sample_floor.definition_of_decision: one evaluation per pair per FX session at 16:00-NY; a trade = one entry fill + one exit fill
turnover_and_sample_floor.expected_decisions_per_arm: approximately 1750 per pair (2019-01..2026-09 minus 252-session warmup), 7 pairs

expected_trades.anchor: 6-14 band crossings per pair over the sample -> 42-98 anchor trades; band estimate, not a promise
expected_trades.control: similar magnitude by construction (same band mechanics on a differently-shifted differential)

sample_floor.fold_population: every fold must contain >= 12 populated anchor trades or the fold is recorded NOT_POPULATED and fails the fold gate
sample_floor.band_caveat: crossing counts depend on the (currently unwired) CPI path; if the realized count lands below the floor the recorded verdict is SAMPLE_FLOOR_FAIL with no parameter rescue

folds_plan.scheme: 3 equal chronological time folds, force-flat at boundaries, purge gap = 20 sessions (one holding period) between folds
folds_plan.stage_a_note: gate: >= 2 of 3 populated folds positive (fin-adj); fold-positive share reported

drop_one_pair.procedure: 7 refits, one per pair dropped, anchor only, frozen parameters untouched
drop_one_pair.gate: dropout survival >= 6 of 8 scenarios (inherited V3 M1-DEV binding: 7 pair-drops + best-fold-drop)
drop_one_pair.interpretation: a family that needs any one pair to pass is pair-concentrated and fails; the dropped pair identity is recorded, never acted on

drop_one_fold.gate: survival counted in the same 6-of-8 denominator
drop_one_fold.interpretation: single-fold dependence is recorded as fragility, margin-to-fail reported

failure_interpretation.expectancy_nonpositive: the real-differential drift is absent at the 20-session horizon under evidenced availability on this universe/window; consistent with Meese-Rogoff; no rescue by threshold, window, clock or pair changes
failure_interpretation.pf_below_1.10: edge, if any, is too small against 3.0 bps round-trip; recorded as cost-dominated
failure_interpretation.stress_tier_fail: economics exist only at unstressed costs - explicitly not a survivor (V3R lesson)
failure_interpretation.control_reproduces_anchor: the inflation channel is non-causal: the machinery is a nominal-differential mechanism wearing a real-rate label; family fails the causal gate even if profitable, and the finding is recorded as an axis-1 contamination observation, not a rescuable PnL
failure_interpretation.sample_floor_fail: insufficient signal events; family unscored-on-substance, recorded NOT_PROMOTABLE for data-scarcity, a distinct verdict from a scored rejection
failure_interpretation.mdd_or_concentration_fail: risk-shape violation independent of profitability; no override

source_to_test_map.test: ledger re-hash equality at implementation freeze; PIT read test: no decision uses a rate before its evidenced stamp (availability-lag mutation test: shifting stamps forward must change books, shifting backward must be impossible)

source_to_test_map.test: only-availability-differs invariant vs raw series; per-print availability-lag mutation test per area
cost once per fill; stress multipliers reach booked stress PnL (regression inherited from P1 phase)
control-runs-under-evidenced-semantics gate: the control book must execute (nonzero decisions) - a refused/empty control book is a DESIGN FAILURE, not a pass
8-scenario dropout harness, 3-fold force-flat harness, benchmark twin mechanics per inherited scored_runner conventions

margin_to_fail_expectations.note: no PnL exists at D1 (outcome-blind lane); these are priors over gate margins, frozen so post-hoc surprises are legible

per_gate.expectancy_gt_0_fin_adj: HIGH FAILURE RISK: real-differential effects documented in the literature are horizon-dependent and historically small at 20 sessions; plausible ex-ante drift band 0-5 bps per trade vs 3.0 bps round-trip cost -> margin expected inside one standard error
per_gate.folds_2of3_positive: moderate risk; real-yield-capture profitability clusters in tightening cycles (2022-23) versus easing (2019-21), so fold heterogeneity is expected
per_gate.mdd_within_frozen_ceiling: LOW risk: 20-session FX holds at unit notional across 7 pairs historically fit inherited ceilings
per_gate.pair_concentration_within_ceiling: LOW risk: signal is cross-sectional by construction (every pair conditions on its own differential)
per_gate.stress_tier_1.5: HIGH failure risk given thin base margins (tier multiplies booked PnL; a +1.5 bps mean becomes net-negative under x1.5 loss scaling on losers)
per_gate.stress_tier_2.0_PRIMARY: HIGH failure risk - the most likely single gate to kill this family; ex-ante arithmetic: if base expectancy < 3.0 bps/trade the doubled-loss tier book is negative (the exact shape that invalidated V3 family2)
per_gate.drop_one_6of8: moderate risk; USD-leg pairs may dominate (US appears in 7 of 7 area maps as base or quote)
per_gate.usd_drift_within_bounds: LOW risk; benchmark arm absorbs the shared USD component by construction
per_gate.incremental_alpha_gt_0: moderate-to-high risk: 2022-23 Fed cycle may align the real signal with USD momentum, shrinking the benchmark-adjusted edge
per_gate.neighbour_supports: HIGH expected support (same mechanism, normalization variant only)
per_gate.control_does_not_reproduce: moderate confidence the control differs (2021-23 inflation differentials were large); this is also the gate where the family's honesty is tested
per_gate.reproduction_ALL_MATCH: LOW risk; read as self-consistency only (P-4)

margin_to_fail_expectations.overall_prior: given Meese-Rogoff priors and frozen stress arithmetic, the modal ex-ante outcome is a scored negative or a tier-gate kill; that is an acceptable and reportable result per P-6

constraint_compliance.no_new_data_sources: only already-adopted keyless sources (BIS WS_CBPOL adopted; BIS WS_LONG_CPI already staged per P2 authority; national agency static calendars used ONLY as evidence artifacts in the existing ledger pattern, no new vendor, no key, no purchase)

novelty_self_check.vs_V1_family1_session_open_momentum_cont: no session clocks, no intraday structures - daily 16:00-NY macro conditioning; disjoint
novelty_self_check.vs_V3_family1: V3 family1 was a momentum+drift-gated structure (rejected on expectancy); this packet has no price-momentum term; disjoint in signal, shares only the daily clock
novelty_self_check.vs_V3_family2_invalidated: V3 family2 = realized-vol-gated NOMINAL policy-differential carry. This packet differs in signal construction (real differential nets inflation against rates; sign flips in identifiable states), has no volatility gate, and adds the causal placebo that separates the inflation channel. DISCLOSED RISK: the policy-rate leg is shared machinery; A7-N must measure rank correlation against BOTH the as-scored and evidenced-corrected V3 family2 anchor books; this packet is NOT a Section 1.1 front-door re-entry (that door belongs to the carry axis) and accepts veto if A7-N finds the inflation term inert (rho ~ 1 after conditioning)
novelty_self_check.vs_naive_carry: signable disagreement states exist (see mechanism.why_this_is_NOT_a_policy_carry_relabel); the placebo arm measures exactly this
novelty_self_check.rescue_operations: none: no threshold, window, clock, pair-subset, sign-inversion or cost relief is available to this family under any outcome
